summary: KB Financial Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 21, 2026, reporting a routine change in share ownership by its largest shareholder, the Korean National Pension Service. The stake decreased from 32,734,500 shares (9.23%) to 32,622,276 shares (9.20%), based on the shareholder registry dated August 7, 2026. This is an ordinary disclosure required of a foreign private issuer and does not involve a corporate event, transaction, or strategic action. No deal terms, recommendations, or advisors were identified. No special-situation angle applies; the change is immaterial and procedural.
